description: This file defines the AttendanceProvider class which manages attendance operations in a Flutter application. It handles marking attendance (single and bulk), fetching attendance data (for today and date ranges), offline queue synchronization, and real-time updates via WebSocket. It integrates with core components such as API client, environment configuration, local storage, and real-time services, and interacts with the Attendance model.

classes.name: AttendanceProvider
classes.description: Manages attendance data, including marking, fetching, offline queuing, and real-time updates within a Flutter app.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the provider, setting up real-time subscriptions and preparing offline queue.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels real-time subscriptions and cleans up resources.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks attendance for a single user and course on a specific date, with offline fallback.

methods.name: bulkMark
methods.description: Marks attendance for multiple users for a specific course and date.

methods.name: fetchToday
methods.description: Fetches today's attendance data, either from mock data or backend API, and caches it.

methods.name: fetchRange
methods.description: Fetches attendance data within a specified date range, with caching and range-based API call.

methods.name: syncOfflineQueue
methods.description: Attempts to send queued offline attendance entries to backend for synchronization.

methods.name: _handleRealtimeMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming real-time messages related to attendance updates.

methods.name: _applyInboundAttendance
methods.description: Updates local caches with an inbound Attendance object.

methods.name: _enqueue
methods.description: Adds a failed API request payload to the offline queue for later retry.

methods.name: _formatDateKey
methods.description: Creates a date string key in the format 'yyyy-MM-dd' for cache indexing.
